redaction: New installer captures use local 12px blur before writing PNGs, including low-effects mode and visible tooltips. Two legacy images use Gaussian blur baked into their PNG pixels; original/output hashes, regions, pixel checks and visual review are recorded separately. Unblurred captures and OCR text are excluded from published assets.
limits: OCR and pattern checks can miss account names, QR codes, private hosts or illegible text. This report does not certify every asset as free of sensitive information; new or changed media requires another review.
